title: Nikkei: US tech AI obligations jump 90% to $3.2T
summary: A Nikkei report says US technology companies&\#x27; AI-related obligations rose 90% over six months to $3.2 trillion, a figure the report frames as hidden AI debt. The "debt" label is contested because the total reportedly includes signed future-spending contracts, data-center leases, and power payments, not only borrowed money, and the contract terms are not detailed. The report&\#x27;s significance lies in the scale and rapid growth of commitments tied to AI infrastructure and in how much exposure may sit outside conventional debt measures.
